full_prompt_en: The image is a square abstract oil painting of stacked orange, blue, pink, gray, and white color blocks with a narrow dark blue horizontal band. The upper background is divided into two large cool planes: muted slate blue on the left and a slightly lighter lavender-blue on the right. Rising from just left of center, a tall saturated orange rectangle reaches the top edge and narrows the space between those cool fields. Its painted sides are almost straight but visibly irregular, with a small darker ochre extension on its right at midheight. Beneath the orange, a deeper brick-red block steps downward and overlaps the pale lower structures. Across the middle, a thin deep blue strip runs horizontally from the left edge behind the central blocks toward the right. A broad dusty pink area fills the left lower middle, while lighter pink and warm gray strips continue across the right. Near the center, small white, cream, mustard, mauve, orange, and charcoal rectangles cluster tightly together, their irregular edges meeting and partly covering one another. One bright white vertical block rises above this cluster slightly right of center and catches the eye against the soft blue background. The lower left holds a muted rose-brown rectangle, interrupted by narrow off-white vertical passages. On the lower right, a broad medium gray plane extends to the edge, its matte surface darker than the pale central whites but lighter than the thin blue band. The entire surface carries thick, uneven pigment and faint scrape marks, especially where one block ends and another begins. Light appears flat and ambient, with no cast shadow or illusion of a single lamp; contrast arises from adjacent color values and the small rough ridges of paint. The arrangement suggests shallow overlapping planes without a fixed object or realistic space. The overall composition balances the tall warm orange accent and compact pale center against broad cool upper fields and a quiet gray lower mass.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅方形抽象油画，橙、蓝、粉、灰与白色块层层堆叠，中间有一道细窄的深蓝水平带。上部背景分成两块宽阔冷色平面：左侧低饱和板岩蓝，右侧稍浅的薰衣草蓝。从中央稍偏左的位置升起一条饱和橙色长方形，直抵顶边，压窄两块冷色域之间的空间。它的绘画边缘大体平直却明显不规则，中部右侧伸出一小段较暗赭色。橙色下方一块更深的砖红色逐级下落，盖在下方浅色结构前。一条细深蓝带从左边缘横穿中部，在中央色块后延伸到右侧。左侧中下部被宽大的灰粉色区域占据，较浅的粉色与暖灰色条带继续横向伸向右边。靠近中央，白、奶油、芥末、灰紫、橙与炭黑色的小长方块紧密聚在一起，粗糙边缘相接并部分互相遮盖。其中一块明亮白色竖块在中心稍右处升过小色块群，在柔蓝背景前格外醒目。左下是低饱和玫瑰棕色长方块，被细窄米白色竖带打断。右下方一片宽阔的中灰平面伸到画边，哑光表面比中央浅白处深，却比细蓝带浅。整幅表面带厚而不匀的颜料和淡淡刮痕，尤其在一块颜色结束、另一块开始的位置。光线平坦而均匀，没有投影或单一灯光的幻觉；反差来自相邻色块的明度和颜料细小的粗糙隆起。排列暗示浅浅交叠的平面，却没有固定物件或写实空间。整体构图以高耸的暖橙强调和紧凑浅色中心，对照宽大的冷色上部和安静的灰色下部。
style_prompt_en: Thick oil paint organizes the surface into broad, matte geometric areas whose boundaries remain slightly chipped and irregular. Cool slate and powder blue take up generous space, contrasted with a tall hot orange accent, dusty pink, warm gray, and concentrated off-white. Small dense color fragments collect around one focal zone, while wider uninterrupted planes give the cluster scale. Rectangular edges are largely vertical and horizontal, but visible scraping and uneven pigment prevent mechanical precision. Color value, overlap, and a narrow dark band establish shallow depth without cast shadows or conventional perspective. Illumination is even, letting warm-cool area relationships and subtle paint relief define the form. The overall treatment is balanced but not symmetrical, tactile yet restrained, with the largest chromatic accent offset by quiet cool masses.
style_prompt_zh: 厚油彩把表面组织成宽大的哑光几何区域，边界仍略有缺口与不规则。冷板岩蓝和粉蓝占据宽裕空间，对照一条高耸热橙色强调、灰粉、暖灰和集中的米白。密集的小色片聚在一处焦点，较宽且不被打断的平面给色片群提供尺度。长方边缘大体水平或竖直，但可见刮痕和不均匀颜料避免机械般精确。色彩明度、遮挡和一条细深色带建立浅纵深，没有投影或常规透视。光照均匀，让冷暖色面积关系和细微颜料隆起定义形体。整体处理平衡却不对称，有触感而克制，最强的色彩强调由安静冷色大块抵住。
theme_en: An abstract arrangement of orange, blue, pink, gray, and white painted blocks
theme_zh: 橙、蓝、粉、灰与白色颜料块组成的抽象构图
name: Nicolas de Stael
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
